coverage: Not yet populated with independently verified state-level incident records

methodology.primary_metric: Potentially affected voters or ballots, only when grounded in a cited primary source
count_rules: Never equate records flagged, lawsuits filed, or challenges submitted with votes lost.
Record separate counts for potentially exposed, confirmed affected, remedied, and unresolved; unknown values are null.
Never subtract remediations from exposure without proof they refer to the same population.
Never sum potentially overlapping incidents into a statewide unique-voter total.
Preserve units: voters, ballots, registrations, and records are not interchangeable.
Store earliest/latest date, geographic scope, mechanism, source and verification status for each incident.
Do not infer partisan effects or probability of fraud from incident counts.
